title: plantago coronopus subsp. weldenii
intro: Plantago coronopus subsp. weldenii, commonly known as Buck's-hoary plantain, is a subspecies of the broad-leaved plantain, a member of the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, wounds, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Buck's-hoary plantain include the relief of bronchitis, coughs, and sore throats, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
